reconstruction.reference_hdl_preconditions: Run reference_hdl from the root of the CVA6 checkout at cpu_revision, with core/cache_subsystem/hpdcache initialized as the cv-hpdcache submodule containing commit f404e7ebbda8baa4af3729535f520a6b12a06d03. Verify SHA-256 7f37b2fb12fa9216b36d1a959619aada6b2e09810a3c9784d55a82d0a71412fc of the retrieved source before use.
reconstruction.test_sources: Check out the recorded riscv-arch-test revision and select the recorded standard RV32 test list.

port_test.configuration: N=2 with the cv32a60x memory request layout, the configuration of both cv32a60x instances. Runs before the 38 CPU programs.
port_test.comparison: Check upstream ready and downstream valid for all eight steps. When valid, also check the request payload and the zero-based index of the selected requester. Check simultaneous requests and a held selection when a higher-priority request arrives during backpressure.
port_test.environment: Verilator 5.008 with --binary --timing --assert, a C++ toolchain and make. VERILATOR may override the executable. The HPDcache submodule must contain commit f404e7ebbda8baa4af3729535f520a6b12a06d03 for the four helper modules. Only the target module is compiled from the submission, using the same module boundaries as CVA6 integration.
port_test.result: A successful simulation records eight checks, zero errors and READ_ARBITER_PORT_TEST_COMPLETE. The fixed bench builds and runs with the reference module, so a build failure, an abnormal end, a missing or incomplete observation record and an explicit mismatch return 1. Missing fixed tools or inputs, resource exhaustion and wall-clock timeouts return 2.
